title: Co-assembly of nanopesticides of abamectin B1a and imidacloprid against Ditylenchus destructor
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01152J, Paper
Rourou Wang, Fei Pan, Ming Niu, Jing Zhou, Haitao Long, Lumei Pu, Weibing Xu, Runtian Ma, Haitao Yu
A carrier-free pesticide is successfully synthesized by the co-assembly of abamectin B1a and imidacloprid. The mechanism of co-assembly and the anti-nematode activity were studied.
